text: The Polymorphism Conjecture in type theory asks whether:
choices: every polymorphic function is the identity
every term of type ∀α.α→α in System F is definitionally equal to the identity
all System F terms are parametric
there is only one term of type ∀α.α→α
explanation: By parametricity, the ONLY closed term of type ∀α.α→α in System F is the identity. This is not a 'conjecture' in the traditional sense — it is a theorem of parametricity.
